reviews.text: I used this mask in the morning after toner/hyaluronic acid serum. It comes with sooo much serum, in fact the mask is almost dripping when it comes out of the packaging. Using it for 20 minutes left my skin bright and glowing immediately after, and sensation-wise it feels very refreshing and clarifying but not astringent. I am incredibly satisfied with the end result, will definitely be purchasing more of these for future occasions. I even had enough leftover serum to apply to my neck and some other areas with discoloration/hyperpigmentation (underarms).
reviews.zh: 我朝早喺爽膚水／玻尿酸精華之後用咗呢款面膜。面膜入面附有好多精華，其實取出嚟嗰陣面膜幾乎滴緊精華。敷咗 20 分鐘，之後皮膚即刻變得亮澤有光采，感覺好清爽、令皮膚清透，但唔會好收斂。我對最終效果非常滿意，以後有需要嗰陣一定會再買多啲。我仲剩低咗足夠嘅精華，可以塗喺頸同其他有色素沉澱嘅位置（例如腋下）。

reviews.text: Again, love love some by mi sheet masks for their serumy texture ( not ampoule thick ones that don't really sink into your skin). Atp tried every some by mi masks, and if you are on lookout for hydrating sheet masks go for it!
reviews.zh: 我又一次好鍾意 Some By Mi 嘅面膜，因為佢哋質地似精華（唔係嗰種好濃稠、好難吸收入皮膚嘅安瓶式面膜）。到而家我試過 Some By Mi 每一款面膜，如果你想搵保濕面膜，就試吓啦！

reviews.text:
I tried this whitening+anti wrinkle formula for the first time.This is great one for tired ,dull and dehydrated skin,tackle pigmentation issues and with the power of Yuja extract,niacinamide , glutathione,Alpha arbutin and vitamins complex the formula leaves skin clear soft and bright I will definitely continue using these sheet mask for blemish care Yuja Niacin mask is non irritatant but it is advise not to use on wounded skin it also contains Panthenol & Hyaluronic acid for intensive hydration care .the formula has many beneficial favorite ingredients..so it's perfect treat for your skin this fall.. 🍂 
My skin feels so relaxed ,soft and moisturised after single use ,soothing mask is for every skin types,locks moisture and nutrients into skin,,Best option for clear and dewy skin.. 💛 Absolutely no stickiness, sheet mask is vegan , hypoallergenic , dermatologist tested and free from harmful ingredients..
reviews.zh:
我第一次試咗呢款美白＋抗皺配方。呢款好適合疲勞、暗啞同缺水嘅皮膚，針對色素問題。配合柚子萃取、菸酰胺、穀胱甘肽、α-熊果苷同維他命複合成分，配方令皮膚變得清透、柔軟又亮白。我一定會繼續用呢啲面膜護理痘痕。Yuja Niacin 面膜唔刺激，但建議唔好用喺受傷嘅皮膚上。佢仲含有泛醇同玻尿酸，做深層保濕。配方有好多好嘅成分……所以係秋天嘅完美護膚選擇。🍂
用完一次之後，我嘅皮膚感覺好舒緩、柔軟同水潤。呢款舒緩面膜適合所有膚質，鎖住水分同養分喺皮膚入面，亦都係追求清透、水潤皮膚嘅最佳選擇。💛 完全唔黏，呢款面膜係素食、低敏、經皮膚科測試，冇有害成分……

reviews.text: Some By Mi Yuja Niacin Mask is something that my 18 year old daughter has been wanting for a long time, and this time, it came as a surprise gift from me. She absolutely loved the mask effects as there was more clarity and vitality in her now smooth complexion ! I would without a doubt repurchase so what are you waiting for? If you want fresh and dewy skin then get this mask! You won’t regret it.
reviews.zh: Some By Mi Yuja Niacin 面膜係我 18 歲嘅女兒一直都好想要嘅嘢，今次係我送畀佢嘅驚喜禮物。佢好鍾意面膜嘅效果，因為佢而家光滑嘅膚質更清透、更有活力！我毫無疑問會再買，所以你仲等咩呢？如果你想要清新、水潤嘅皮膚，就快啲買呢款面膜啦！你唔會後悔嘅。

reviews.text: This is such an amazing sheet mask. It’s really refreshing especially if you have combo to dry skin. I like how it feels and that it leaves my skin feeling so well moisturized. It brightens the complexion just a little bit. Smells good in my opinion.
reviews.zh: 呢款面膜真係好正。尤其係如果你係混合至乾性皮膚，用落真係好清爽。我鍾意佢嘅感覺，而且用完皮膚感覺好滋潤。佢令膚色稍為亮白咗少少。我覺得佢聞落幾好聞。

reviews.text: I use the some by mi serum on a daily basis. This mask is soaked in the serum and smells nice too. Not sure if it's just me but I felt my skin got brighter after using this mask.
reviews.zh: 我每日都用 some by mi 嘅精華。呢款面膜浸滿咗精華，味道都好好聞。唔知係咪淨係我咁覺得，但係我覺得用完呢款面膜之後皮膚亮咗。

reviews.text: It is a very good mask, I bought 3 , because of the great reviews that she has and now I understand why. this mask make my skin very soft and more bright. I will by more of it and I will propose it to my friends
reviews.zh: 呢款面膜好好用，我買咗三個，因為佢有好多好評，而家我明白點解。呢款面膜令我嘅皮膚好軟滑、更亮白。我會再買多啲，仲會推薦畀我嘅朋友。

reviews.text: It was very hydrating and plumping. This mask is for brightening and I did experience brightening effects about two days after using this mask. I was pleasantly surprised by the results as it brightened the hyperpigmentation from old acne. I bought this to see if I would like the serum, and I would definitely give the serum a try.
reviews.zh: 佢好保濕，亦都好飽滿。呢款面膜係用嚟提亮嘅，我用完之後兩日真係見到提亮效果。效果令我好驚喜，因為佢令舊痘留下嘅色素沉澱都淡咗。我買呢款係想試吓我會唔會鍾意精華，而我一定會試吓嗰款精華。
